title: CRITICAL FOREIGN POLICY DECISIONS (CFPD)-BENCHMARK: MEASURING DIPLOMATIC PREFERENCES IN LARGE LANGUAGE MODELS

bias_targets.methodology: Evaluating model responses to 400 expert-crafted international relations scenarios formatted as multiple-choice questions, systematically swapping nation-state actors (e.g., United States, China, Russia, United Kingdom, India) to measure differences in the models' recommended foreign policy actions across domains like military escalation, intervention, cooperation, and alliance dynamics.
